evidence: Applied the skill's procedure for check 5 (references/quality-checks.md:25-27). (1) Case-insensitive grep of instruction.md, environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md, environment/instructions/integration.md and environment/Dockerfile for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel plus extended terms probe|gate|grader|grading|verif|oracle|harbor|test.sh|checker|mcp|restart_app|scored|polish|visual|functional|render|constraints|evaluat|assess returned zero matches; the same word list over environment/assets/seed_data.json returned zero matches. (2) Criterion ids (hro_gate_shared, hro_gate_render, hro_intake_restart ... hro_candidate, hro_pol_*, hro_vis_*) and dimension names: grep for 'hro_' / 'hro-' in brief, notes and seed returned nothing; dimension names (render/constraints/functional/polish/visual) absent. (3) Probe literals: the judge prompts/criteria use ordinary values (e.g. functional judge.toml:31 note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.', polish judge.toml:25 'Call back on Fri'); no GATE-PROBE-style sentinel exists and none of these appear in the brief/notes. (4) Verbatim overlap: no 10-word shingle shared between any public file (brief + both notes) and app_context.md / any prompt.md / any judge.toml; at 7 words the only shared run is 'its most recent 30 messages oldest of' (hireops_rules.md:151 vs functional judge.toml), which is the public requirement being quoted by the grader, not grader text leaking into the brief. (5) Agent image: environment/Dockerfile copies only instructions/ and assets/; tests/ is not in the agent build context, and integration.md/hireops_rules.md mention only agent-facing paths (/app, /assets, /instructions, DB_PATH). (6) Colderwater lessons bearing on this row: lesson 1/12 (do not mirror criteria or tell the builder how to build just so the grader can test) - checked; the closest candidates are instruction.md:13 'check it yourself the way we'll use it: sign in as two of us in separate browsers...' (requester voice, names no judge/tool, Colderwater lesson 5 pattern), hireops_rules.md:80-81 refusal 'says ... by whom, so whatever screen or tool sent the move can tell them' (user reason given, not a grader hook), hireops_rules.md:207-211 locked-down launch environment and env list (runtime contract in requester voice; names no test path or verifier), and HTTP status codes 401/403/404/409 (product API contract). None names the judge, rubric, dimensions, weights, test paths or sentinels. Lesson 13 (public internet address) not applicable to the brief: the brief references no external site. Counterexample search: this is a brief-text row, so a broken app or conforming alternative cannot change it; the only failing mode would be a builder learning grader internals from the brief, and no such content was found. Workbook internal annotation for #5 is empty, so no extra interpretation applies. Source-only check; no runtime evidence is required for this row.
